description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve information about employee immigration records, including date formatting, country name resolution, and document type mapping.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional behaviors and data formatting for EmployeeImmigrationRecord entities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeImmigrationRecord instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the immigration record using an employee number.

methods.name: getCountryName
methods.description: Retrieves the country name based on the country code from the immigration record.

methods.name: getDocumentType
methods.description: Gets the human-readable document type based on its mapped value.
